fsync_trace_summary.scope: All traced filesystem fsync/fdatasync calls, including setup and drain. Elapsed syscall time includes ptrace perturbation and OS scheduling, not pure device latency. Failed and unfinished calls are not successful durability; not an unperturbed capacity result.
